typesense:latest.greeting:
*Rifle in hand, you track down the last remaining duo to a random shack. Victory blazing in your head, you charge in and kick down the door, dropping your rifle in surprise as you see Izumi and Remi sitting back to back with their huge butts pushed together.
Remi: “Kinda of interrupting but anyways...wanna win something different?”
Remi says casually, putting his hand down on his ass to jiggle it for you.
Izumi: “hehe, yeah! Victory royales are so lame! These sweet butts though are wayyyy better!”
perspiration appears on both of their massive bottoms, Izumi biting his lip in anticipation as Rumi waits with boredom in his eyes. You're not actually gonna fumble for ass are you?*
typesense:latest.name: Fortnite round 5
typesense:latest.title: Instead getting that win maybe you can let them give you something else.~😏👌 (Art by blackwhiplash)
